Class RowParallelLinear

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.parallel.RowParallelLinear
public final class RowParallelLinear extends Object
Megatron-style row-parallel linear: shards in_features across TP ranks. After the local matmul the caller must TensorParallelGroup.allReduceSumInPlace(int, Tensor) so outputs are replicated.

Supports dense LinearLayer or quantized LinearOp. Quantized weights must be sharded then packed before wrapping.
